links.outcome: Reading level of existing radiology patient education materials versus sixth-grade target
links.effect: Original materials had an average reading level of 11.72, above the recommended sixth-grade level; generative AI reduced ARL to 7.32 (ChatGPT) and 6.55 (Gemini).
links.quote: The original materials had an ARL of 11.72.

links.outcome: Reading level of patient education materials relative to plain-language target
links.effect: Original ARL 11.72 exceeded the sixth-grade target; ChatGPT ARL 7.32 ± 0.76 and Gemini ARL 6.55 ± 0.51 after simplification, with some information loss (Gemini 68% retaining at least 75% of information).
links.quote: The original materials had an ARL of 11.72.

links.effect: Original materials had ARL 11.72, above the recommended sixth-grade ARL.
links.quote: The original materials had an ARL of 11.72.
ChatGPT ARL was 7.32 ± 0.76 (6/7 significant) and Gemini ARL was 6.55 ± 0.51 (7/7 significant).

links.effect: ChatGPT versus Gemini: appropriate 95% vs. 57%, clear 92% vs. 67%, relevant 95% vs. 76%.
links.quote: ChatGPT outputs were more appropriate (95% vs. 57%), clear (92% vs. 67%), and relevant (95% vs. 76%) than Gemini.

links.effect: Gemini retained at least 75% of information in 68% of outputs.
links.quote: Gemini reduced word count by 33% ± 7%, with 68% retaining at least 75% of information.

links.outcome: Average reading level of AI-simplified patient education materials
links.effect: ChatGPT achieved an ARL of 7.32 ± 0.76 and Gemini 6.55 ± 0.51, failing to achieve the recommended sixth-grade reading level despite improving from 11.72
links.quote: Generative AI significantly enhances the readability of patient education materials, which did not achieve the recommended sixth-grade ARL.
